decision: Sam's explicit decision of 2026-11-04 in Claude Code session f804490c on the TASK-016 CI admission proposal: "全部批准，我作為project owner 批準你幫我發digest", approving 18 new functional cases, the unchanged re-pin of the 13 inputs pinned by receipts these changes invalidate, and a one-time project-owner authorization for the agent to publish this receipt's digest; recorded in docs/purchasing_receiving_management/implementation/P1_task016_po_list_detail_copy.md
purpose: PO list and detail return only the safe projection with stable sorting, allowlisted filters and search, fixed query count and current-master differences kept apart from snapshots; Copy creates a new Draft and keeps only values that are still valid, with warnings, without status, receipt or approval state; routes enforce purchasing.view or purchasing.mgmt, idempotency and PURCHASING_INPUT_INVALID. Also re-pins unchanged Purchasing tests and support files because receipts bind their whole file set
data: Inquiry and Copy cases: minimal masters and at most about 10 POs per case in a rolled-back transaction; one inquiry case inserts 101 Suppliers and 101 SKUs, also rolled back. API cases commit minimal masters and POs, delete them afterwards, and leave operation, audit and sequence rows (those tables refuse DELETE). Handler file: no database. Re-pinned files keep their approved data unchanged. No fixture files
concurrency: None in the new cases; existing and re-pinned cases unchanged
thresholds: All cases pass; list query count does not grow with PO or line volume
trigger: Routine correctness regression on every PR and push to main, in the existing server coverage shards
cost: Measured locally per file: inquiry 0.24 s, Purchase Order service 0.39 s, API 2.8 s, handler 0.1 s; the new cases add about 2 s. CI not measured, estimated under 5 s added. No new job and no capacity

cases: 列表預設按更新時間同 ID 倒序，分頁穩定；summary 係交易快照同安全欄位，allowedActions 跟 DB 權限
每個 filter 都會篩，日期範圍包頭包尾，條件之間係 AND
q 搵 PO 編號、Supplier code／名稱、SKU code／名稱、barcode 同 Supplier Reference，已停用主檔都搵到；通配符只係普通字
Outstanding 只計已確認、收緊貨嘅 PO（HD-017 4A）；進度分開計，超收唔抵銷其他行，風險有文字碼
列表 query 數量固定，唔跟 PO 同 Line 數量增加
詳情回交易快照同逐行進度，目前主資料另外放；只回有分別嘅，唔露 Supplier 內部欄位
名稱配中超過 100 個時，完全相符嘅 Supplier code 同 SKU code 唔會畀上限截走
唔存在嘅 ID 回一致 404；撤咗權嘅 token 讀唔到
create 拎月度編號、server 計快照同金額、operation 同 Audit 一齊寫，而 Inventory 唔郁
同一 eventId 同內容 replay 唔會再建；唔同內容係衝突並寫 REJECTED audit
update 完整取代 Lines：保留 ID、重排、刪除、新增，重算 Total 同 version
update 拒絕過時 version、外來 child ID、非 Draft 同唔存在嘅 PO，乜都唔改並寫 REJECTED audit
新揀嘅 Supplier、SKU、UOM、地址、倉、Buyer 同 Currency 一定要當下合格；冇 Supplier-SKU relation 唔阻
Update 時冇郁而之後先失效嘅 Supplier／SKU 照存並回 warning；新揀或者換咗就拒絕（HD-015 1B）
Audit 失敗令成單 rollback；權限過時被拒；REJECTED audit 寫唔到就記 security log
兩個人同時用同一 version 保存：PO 行鎖令第二個人收到 VERSION_CONFLICT，唔會覆蓋（AC-010）
copy 建新編號、新 ID 嘅 Draft，唔抄狀態、進度同舊資格；來源唔郁，operation 同 Audit 指返來源
copy 只抄仍然合法嘅值：選填主檔清空、Buyer 換操作者、唔合格 Line 剔走，全部有 warning（HD-017 2A）
copy 遇到不可採購 Supplier、冇 Line 剩低或者唔存在嘅來源就成張拒絕，寫 REJECTED Audit；要 purchasing.mgmt
copy 逐個條件剔走唔合格嘅 Line：UOM 停用、唔再追蹤庫存、改咗 serial、factor 改咗換唔到整數
Create 經 HTTP 回 201；同 key 同內容 replay、同 key 唔同內容 409；key 同 eventId 唔一致或者帶 client total 被拒
Update 經 HTTP 回 200；舊 version 409 只回 currentVersion；冇 purchasing.mgmt 403、冇 token 401
List 同 Detail 經 HTTP：view 讀到過咗 response schema 嘅安全 projection；mgmt 冇 view 403、冇 token 401、唔存在 404
Copy 經 HTTP 回 201 同新編號；同 key replay；只有 view 403、冇 token 401、唔存在 404
Handler metadata：POST、jwt、只要 purchasing.mgmt、開 idempotency、create 201／update 200
Handler 用真 provider 同 config 組 service：Supplier 接 Business Master，audit 上限跟 config
Create 將 JWT claims、原 body 同 request context 交畀 service，回 201
Update 要 version，PO ID 嚟自 path，回 200
Idempotency-Key 一定要同 eventId 逐字相同；冇 key 或者唔同都唔叫 service
Schema 拒絕 client total、快照、factor、Base quantity、status 同 line ID（create），錯誤帶欄位路徑
數量同金額要係原本嘅字串，唔會 coerce；其他型別錯誤都指出欄位
Read handler metadata：GET、jwt、只要 purchasing.view；唔開 idempotency，query 同 response 都係白名單
List 將 query 字串轉型先交畀 service；未知 filter、爛 enum、超上限一律 PURCHASING_INPUT_INVALID
Get 用 path 嘅 ID 同 JWT claims 叫 service
Copy metadata 同 create 一樣要 mgmt 同 idempotency；body 只收 eventId，來源 ID 嚟自 path，回 201
TC-012 real HTTP authentication and authorized admin flow
global configuration validation normalizes every configuration section
TC-006 (MIG-006): adding Supplier to an existing deployment changes no existing table or row, writes only Supplier tables and its permission seed, drops nothing it does not own, and the server starts
TASK-011 migrations create the four tables in the approved shape and rerun as no-ops
TASK-011 the settings default is seeded only when missing and never overwrites a saved value
TASK-011 document sequences are isolated by type and month and bounded by CHECK
TASK-011 purchase order numbers, status and currency precision are enforced by the database
TASK-011 the ordering address must belong to the PO's Supplier, and deleted actors become NULL
TASK-011 purchase order lines enforce UOM ownership, bounds, the receipt identity and decimal precision
TASK-011 each migration creates exactly one table, so a failure points at one file
TASK-012 migrations create the operation, audit and trigger schema and rerun as no-ops
TASK-012 an operation is unique per document, line and event, and its identity is validated
TASK-012 an operation completes once, then its identity and outcome are frozen
TASK-012 audit rows are append-only, bounded, and keep working when an actor is deleted
TASK-012 a confirmed PO freezes its commercial fields but keeps lifecycle fields writable
TASK-012 lines of a non-DRAFT PO cannot be edited, added or removed, but projections can
TASK-012 document numbers only move forward and are never deleted
TASK-012 every PO and line column is classified once, triggers drift fails closed, and migrations only add
HD-013 open and historical counts follow the PO status a document is in
HD-013 no purchase_orders table means not installed, and no references means ready with zero counts
HD-013 the watermark changes when a referencing PO changes and only then
HD-013 unclassified statuses, malformed counts and invalid subjects fail closed
HD-013 every status the schema allows is classified exactly once
TASK-010 the defaults are the §12.1 values and the result is frozen
TASK-010 every setting must be a positive safe integer within its limit
TASK-010 unknown settings and schema-bound constants cannot be configured
選填欄位省略即係清空；數量同單價正規化成固定 scale
Client 計嘅 total、快照、factor、Base quantity 同 status 一律係未知欄位
零價一定要 5～500 字原因；非零價唔收原因（BR-011、AC-008）
錯誤指出邊一行邊個欄位；交期唔可以早過 Order Date；Line ID 唔可以重複
Header 欄位、Currency 格式同 Line 數上限
TASK-010 IDs are positive safe integers
TASK-010 eventId is a canonical lowercase UUID the Inventory provider will accept
TASK-010 dates are real calendar days in YYYY-MM-DD
TASK-010 reason is trimmed to 5..500 characters; notes and references are bounded free text
TASK-010 objects are allowlisted, so client totals, snapshots and status never get through
TASK-010 line and detail arrays need at least one item and respect the configured cap
TASK-010 errors carry a stable code and a field name, never the submitted value
